With fixes in time order the engine sees one set; end = GPS lost after the fall (~14:41:55Z).
28 fixes (incl. ~36 km/h riding) recorded after the 14:42:34Z fix. A live engine must not let them rewind its clocks or re-open a set.

Rider reports riding until ~14:58Z (16:50-17:00 local). Only 58-199 m fixes without usable speed were recorded: good fixes stayed stuck behind the hung route insert. Nothing to detect here; the fix is in recording, not detection.
